relations.text: 少なくとも10GW分のNVIDIA製システムをOpenAI向けに導入する基本合意書(2025年9月22日)
relations.text_en: Letter of intent to deploy at least 10GW of NVIDIA systems for OpenAI (September 22, 2025)

source.label: NVIDIA ニュースルーム の発表
source.quote: OpenAI and NVIDIA today announced a letter of intent for a landmark strategic partnership to deploy at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems for OpenAI's next-generation AI infrastructure
source.note: 基本合意書の段階で、確定した契約ではありません。導入は段階的です。
source.note_en: A letter of intent, not a definitive agreement; deployment is phased.

relations.text: システムの導入に合わせて、OpenAIに最大1,000億ドルを出資する意向(2025年9月22日)
relations.text_en: Intends to invest up to $100B in OpenAI as NVIDIA systems are deployed (September 22, 2025)

source.label: NVIDIA ニュースルーム の発表
source.quote: NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI as the new NVIDIA systems are deployed.
source.note: 「意向」「最大」の記載で、基本合意書の段階です。

relations.text: NVIDIAのGrace Blackwell・Vera Rubinシステムで、最大1GWの計算容量を利用すると約束(2025年11月18日、Anthropicの発表)
relations.text_en: Committed to compute capacity of up to 1GW on NVIDIA Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems (November 18, 2025, Anthropic announcement)

source.label: Anthropic announcement
source.quote: Anthropic's compute commitment will initially be up to one gigawatt of compute capacity with NVIDIA Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems.

relations.text: Anthropicに最大100億ドルを出資する契約(NVIDIAの10-Q、2025年11月19日)
relations.text_en: Agreement to invest up to $10B in Anthropic (NVIDIA 10-Q, November 19, 2025)

source.label: NVIDIA 10-Q(quarter ended 2025-10-26)
source.quote: In November 2025, we entered into an agreement, subject to certain closing conditions, to invest up to $ 10 billion in Anthropic.
source.note: 「最大」の記載で、完了条件があります。
